title: Color Hoop: Sort Puzzle
seo_title: Color Hoop Sort Puzzle — Play Free Ring Sorting Game Online
meta_desc: Play Color Hoop: Sort Puzzle free online. Stack colorful hoops onto pillars until each pillar holds one color in this vibrant sorting puzzle.
desc: Color Hoop: Sort Puzzle stacks vibrant rings across a row of pillars. Move the top hoop to a pillar with the same top color or free space, and turn a mixed pile of rings into clean, single-color stacks.
howto: Tap a hoop to lift it off its pillar.
Tap another pillar to drop the hoop onto it.
Hoops sit only on matching colors or where there is room.
Finish when every pillar carries hoops of a single color.
Take on hundreds of progressively trickier boards.
tips: Unbury the bottom hoop of the messiest pillar first.
Short pillars are precious — keep one nearly empty for swaps.
Group hoop colors mentally before your first move.
